name: emil-design-eng
title_zh: 动效不靠灵感靠判断，Emil 的 UI 打磨预设
tagline_zh: 网页要加动画、过渡、微交互时，不再自己瞎试。内置 Emil Kowalski 的动效决策观，告诉你哪里该动。
tagline_en: Stop guessing motion. Emil's design instinct for when, where, and how much to animate—built into every.
desc_en: 你 的動態設計預設：任何『加動畫效果／動態效果／讓頁面更有設計感』的網頁工作一律用這個 skill（含 Open Design 專案與交派 Codex 的頁面設計）。Encodes Emil Kowalski's philosophy on UI polish, component design, animation decisions, and the invisible details that make software feel great. Triggers: 動畫效果, 動態設計, motion, animation, transition, micro-interaction, page polish, 讓頁面更有設計感.
why_zh: 不是动效库，是判断力。它把 Emil 对组件细节、过渡取舍、隐形打磨的标准编码成可执行的规则。
why_en: Not a library—a lens. Encodes Emil's standards for component detail, transition trade-offs, and invisible polish into actionable.
limit_zh: 只覆盖视觉动效与交互打磨，不产出完整 UI 组件库或设计系统；需要已有页面或设计稿作为输入，纯文字需求它无从下手。
limit_en: Only visual motion & interaction polish. Needs an existing page or design as input; no full component systems, no text-only briefs.
title_en: UI polish preset: Emil's motion judgment
